spans.s:
युष्मद् 2nd personal pronoun.
 mfn. (-त्वं) Thou.
 E. युष a Sautra root, to
serve, to worship, Unādi aff. मदिक्.

युष्मद्वाच्य n. (-च्यं) (In gram.) The second person.
 E. युष्मद्, and बाच्य to be said.
यूष् r. 1st cl. (यूषति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.

यूष mn. (-षः-षं) Pease-soup, pease-porridge, the water in which pulse
of various kinds has been boiled.
 m. (-षः) The mulberry tree, (Mo-
rus Indica;) also पूष.
 E. यूष् to hurt, क aff.; यूषन् is optionally subs-
tituted for this word is some cases.
